description: A conveyor belt runs clockwise round the whole kitchen, and it is the only way between the two chefs. One side has the crates, both pans, the sink and the extinguisher; the other has the boards, the plates, the serving counter and the plate return.
strategy: Every burger crosses the belt more than once: beef goes over to be chopped and comes back to be fried. Send several things at once rather than one at a time, since the wait on the belt costs more than the walk. Wash plates in batches too, because they live on the far side from the sink.
